sites.name: Haverstraw brickyards shoreline
sites.notes: Historic Hudson River brickmaking center built on glacial lake clay. Approximate area only; much of the shoreline is private or parkland.

sites.name: Kingston / Rondout Hudson shore
sites.notes: Hudson Valley clay belt with a long brick and cement history. Approximate area; confirm the specific parcel and owner.

sites.name: Athens–Coxsackie clay belt
sites.notes: Historic Hudson River brickyard district. Approximate area only.

sites.name: Lake Albany clay plain
sites.notes: Glacial Lake Albany left thick clay deposits across the Albany area. Approximate area only; construction cuts and creek banks are often private.

sites.name: Garvies Point clay cliffs
sites.notes: Cretaceous clay exposed in shoreline bluffs on Long Island. This is a county preserve and museum, where removing material is normally not allowed. Listed for geology only; check the rules before visiting.
